# sophosfirewall_url_group (Resource)

Manages a web filter URL group (*Protect > Web > URL groups*), a list of domains that web policies and exceptions can allow or block as a whole. An entry matches the domain and all of its subdomains.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sophosfirewall_url_group" "shopping" {
  name        = "Allowed-Shopping"
  description = "Approved shopping domains"
  urls        = ["amazon.com", "ebay.com", "cdn.shopify.com"]
}

# Large lists (up to 10,000 domains per group) are best kept in a file,
# one domain per line.
resource "sophosfirewall_url_group" "blocklist" {
  name = "Blocklist"
  urls = toset(compact(split("\n", file("${path.module}/blocklist.txt"))))
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the URL group. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `urls` (Set of String) Domains or host names in the group, e.g. `example.com` (at most 10,000). Schemes, paths, ports and wildcards are not allowed. Omit to create an empty group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name or UUID.
terraform import sophosfirewall_url_group.example <name-or-uuid>
```
